answer: Picture a desert where a gale drives sand across the horizon, and ten travellers all swear they found the oasis. One oasis cannot be drunk by ten mouths at once: the network caps how much weight may flow through any one cluster of friends, a max-flow gate. Ten clones huddled in one cluster share a single narrow pipe, so ten voices weigh one; a hundred clones in that same cluster still weigh one. One honest agent walking a different road gets its own full pipe and keeps the wage its own steps earned.
